Author: Rajiv Gupta

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 25069 of 2023
Applicant :- Smt Shahnaz Bano

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Kaushalendra Nath Singh,Vinayak Nath Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Ajay Chandragupta
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for O.P. No.2 and learned A.G.A. and
perused the record.

2.  This application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to quash the cognizance order dated 25.4.2023 as well as the entire proceedings of case No. 87958 of 2023, State Vs Abdul Wahab, arising out of case crime no. 0009 of 2023, u/s 498A, 324, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 of D.P. Act.
P.S. Rawatpur, District Kanpur Nagar, pending in the court of A.C.J.M, Kanpur Nagar.

Smt Shahnaz Bano vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198427651/
1 3.

entities.text: Smt Shahnaz Bano vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant has made a statement at the bar, on instructions, that he does not want to press other prayers made in the application and states that the applicant is ready to surrender before the court below and seek her bail and that her release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51.
4.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for O.P. No.2 has submitted that he has no objection to the prayer made by learned counsel for applicant for not pressing the other prayers made in the application.

5. In view of the above, in case the applicant appears before the court below within three weeks from today and seeks bail, his release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51.
6.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: With the aforesaid observations, this application filed u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed of.
